BiblicalUsage: Pelag is a half, a dividing. Daniel says the little horn will wear out the saints until a time and times and the dividing of time — three and a half times, a set season under God's hand.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that even the enemy's season is measured: God sets its length, and it ends when He says.
